```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

# ── Stage 1: deps ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app

COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --ignore-scripts

# ── Stage 2: build ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app

COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
RUN npm run build          # tsc → dist/

# prune to prod deps only
RUN npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts

# ── Stage 3: runtime ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS runtime
WORKDIR /app

ENV NODE_ENV=production

# non-root user (alpine ships this)
USER node

COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/dist          ./dist
COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/package.json  ./

EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

## Why each choice

| Decision | Reason |
|---|---|
| `alpine` base | ~50 MB vs ~900 MB full node image |
| Stage 1 deps | Cache npm install layer; rebuild only when `package*.json` change |
| Stage 2 build | `tsc` + all devDeps present; discarded after |
| `npm ci` not `npm install` | Lockfile-exact, faster, no package.json mutation |
| `--omit=dev` prune | Strip devDeps before copy to runtime |
| Stage 3 copies only `dist/` + `node_modules` | No src, no tsconfig, no devDeps in final image |
| `USER node` | No root in prod. Alpine node image includes `node` user |
| `--chown` on COPY | Files owned by `node` user from the start; no extra `chown` layer |

## Typical size result

```
deps     →  ~250 MB  (discarded)
build    →  ~400 MB  (discarded)
runtime  →   ~80 MB  ✓
```

## Assumed `tsconfig.json` output

```json
{ "compilerOptions": { "outDir": "dist", "rootDir": "src" } }
```

Change `dist/index.js` in CMD if `outDir` differ.
